INSERT INTO site_settings (settingKey, settingValue, label, description, category)
VALUES 
  ('subfloor_sheet_price', '45.00', 'Subfloor Sheet Price ($)', 'Price per sheet of subfloor material (4×8 sheet = 32 sqft). Cost = sheets × price.', 'pricing'),
  ('subfloor_sheet_bonus', '1', 'Subfloor Bonus Sheets (>5)', 'Extra sheets added when total sheets exceed 5 (accounts for cuts/waste on larger decks).', 'pricing')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE settingValue = settingValue;
